OPTIONAL: PHPMailer
The site already sends email through Hostinger SMTP with its built-in mailer (includes/Mailer.php).
If you prefer PHPMailer, download it from https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/releases,
and upload its "src" folder here so the path is:  vendor/PHPMailer/src/PHPMailer.php
It is detected and used automatically. No code changes are needed.
